thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: PROD-GW [us-west-2] — sustained 5xx spike >25% over 2m, latency up. Primary oncall: @sam. Incident severity: P1.

sam: I'm primary but I just got called into an emergency — can't stay on shift. Sorry everyone, I'm in transit. Can someone take primary ASAP? :pray:

maria: I can jump on as primary for the next 3 hours (PST). Taking the bridge now — posting bridge link: https://meet.redwood/bridge/3177778880 

kevin: thanks @maria. Quick note: this looks like the gateway TLS cert rotation fallout we saw yesterday? Early signs: upstream 502s then 5xx surge. Recommending runbook step 2 to rollback recent envoy config.

maria: copying runbook excerpt into thread for whoever's on the bridge:

```
# runbook: gw-5xx-spike
1) Check mem/CPU on gateway nodes: `kubectl top pod -l app=gateway -n prod`
2) If envoy config recently rolled, revert to last config: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/gateway --to-revision=<prev>`
3) Add temporary rate-limit rule to throttle internal scraping: apply `gw-rate-limit-temp.yaml`
4) Open bridge, notify support, escalate to infra if autoscaler misbehaves
```

emma: customer-impact note: Support triage reports ~18 customers with errors for the last 8 minutes (most on write-heavy endpoints). CS already opened case #CS-8421. We should add an update to status.redwood.ai in 15m if no fix.

ajay: on infra — autoscaler is not launching new nodes because of a quota error in the aws account (happens on weekends). I'm on it with infra to request temporary quota bump. ETA ~20m.

kevin: while autoscaler catches up, do the quick mitigation: apply rate-limit patch and revert envoy. I can apply the rate-limit patch if someone reassigns me primary on PagerDuty.

sam: @maria please take over the PD primary — I already acknowledged but can't stay. I'm handing off my checklist to you in DM.

maria: confirmed, I've accepted PD primary. On the bridge and running `kubectl top` now. Seeing spikes on two gateway pods, one OOMKilled earlier.

oncall-bot: Note: reminder to update incident channel when changing primary/secondary. Current PD primary: maria. Secondary: kevin.

kevin: applied temporary rate-limit (hash: rl-temp-317777). Rolling back last envoy config now. Watch logs: `kubectl logs -f deploy/gateway -n prod | grep error`

maria: envoy rollback started. Traffic shaping engaged. Early sign: 5xx rate dropping from 28% -> 12% in 90s.

emma: great — I'm pinging CS and updating the affected customer list. Leaving a short blurb for status page: "Partial outage on write endpoints in us-west-2. Mitigation in progress. Updates every 15 minutes."

ajay: infra confirmed quota bump, autoscaler launching new nodes. New pods coming up, health checks passing on 2/3.

maria: handing off primary back to @kevin in 40m unless we need longer. I'll stay until autoscaler steady state and CS confirms degraded customers are recovered. Thanks for quick responses. :thumbsup: 

kevin: ok to take primary after 40m. Will monitor and file follow-up postmortem including why weekend quota wasn't pre-checked. Assigning action: postmortem owner = kevin.

sam: thanks everyone — sorry for the sudden swap. Let me know if you need any follow-ups from my side.

maria: one last thing — reminder for on-call folks: weekend rotation doc has the AWS quota checklist under Troubleshooting -> Pre-flight. Please scan it before you log out this week: https://wiki.redwood/ops/oncall-weekend-checklist

oncall-bot: Incident P1 mitigated to P2. Continue monitoring for 30m. Next update scheduled in 15m."
